title: Game 14: Marshall–Capablanca
subtitle: Active rooks and a passed h-pawn dominate the ending

steps.title: A queen’s bishop developed without weakness

narration.say: Marshall has White against Capablanca at New York in 1918. Black chooses a solid Queen’s Gambit Declined setup.
Black exchanges central pieces and prepares the bishop’s development on b7.
White gains central space. Both sides put rooks on central files.

steps.title: Meet the pawn advance with piece activity

narration.say: White advances d5. Black responds by centralising the knight.

exercise.prompt: Black to move. Centralise the knight on c5.

steps.title: An active queen meets the threats

narration.say: Black recaptures with the knight. White exchanges the bishop, and Black recaptures with the queen.
The queens are exchanged. Black immediately invades the second rank.

steps.title: Create a target and a passed pawn

narration.say: White advances e5. Black challenges with g5.
Black can lift the rook to e6, keeping the initiative.

exercise.prompt: Black to move. Bring the rook from e8 to e6.

narration.say: White brings the rook to c1. Black improves the king and fixes the queenside pawns.
Black transfers the rook to g6. The other rook takes a2.

exercise.prompt: Black to move. Advance the passed h-pawn.

narration.say: Black secures the queenside with a6. White advances e6, but Black captures it.
White tries to gain space. Black brings the rook to h6.

steps.title: Rooks, king and pawn work together

narration.say: Black repositions the rook, then doubles on the second rank.
The knight checks, but Black’s king advances toward the white pawns.
White retreats the king. Black advances h2 and captures f4 after the check.
White resigns. The active rooks and passed pawn dominate the position.

steps.title: The final game brings the principles together

narration.say: Black developed the queen’s bishop, responded to the centre with active pieces, and kept the rooks mobile.
After the queens were exchanged, the passed h-pawn restricted White and supported the rook invasion.
The king joined the attack. Development, initiative, pawn structure and endgame activity formed one continuous plan.
